items.q: How much does junk removal cost?
items.a: You pay for how much of the truck your junk fills. A 1/8 truck is $149, a 1/4 truck $249, a 1/2 truck $399 and a full truck $649. Loading, hauling and drop-off are included.

items.q: What if I'm not sure how much I have?
items.a: Pick the closest size when you book and add a few photos. We'll confirm the price before the day.

items.q: Can the price change on the day?
items.a: Only if the job is different from what we agreed, like extra items or heavy material we didn't know about. If it does, we tell you before we load anything.

items.q: How much for just one item?
items.a: A single item is priced as a 1/8 load, $149.
Every demo job is different, so we price it per job. Send photos with your booking or call us and we'll talk it through.
Furniture, appliances, mattresses, household junk, garage and basement clutter, yard waste and demo debris. The full list is on our services page.
Paint, oil and chemicals, propane tanks, asbestos, medical waste and car batteries. Not sure about something? Ask us.
Yes, where we can. Tell us what's still good when you book and we'll take it to a local charity or reuse store instead of the dump.

items.q: Do I need to carry anything outside?
items.a: No. We carry it out from wherever it is, including basements and upstairs rooms.
Pick your town, your load and a day online, add photos if you can, and send it. Shawn looks over every booking and gets back to you to confirm the time and the price.

Check the calendar for the next open days. If you need it sooner, call us and we'll see what we can do.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: Not always. If the junk is outside and the price is agreed, we can do the job while you're out. Tell us when you book.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
items.a: Yes. Call us at least a day ahead and we'll move it or cancel it.

items.q: Do you come to my town?
items.a: We cover towns across Massachusetts and New Hampshire. Type yours into the booking form to check, or see the full list on our service area page.
